{{Quote|With regret, I report that my fleet will no longer be able to provide protection to the troops on Ryloth. I repeat my request that help must be sent right away.|Admiral Dao, to the Jedi High Council|<ref name="Supply Lines" />}}
'''Dao''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he commanded a [[Dao's fleet|fleet]] of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], [[Space warfare/Legends|defending]] the [[Ryloth/Legends|planet's]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] inhabitants from a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Ryloth blockade/Legends|invasion fleet]]. After requesting reinforcements from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], Dao was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when his [[Dao's flagship/Legends|flagship]] was destroyed by enemy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[Laser/Legends|fire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We're in trouble down here. We need those supplies immediately.''"<br />"''I understand, General, but I am in no position to help. We are critically low on fuel and ammunition.''"<br />"''Contact the Jedi Council again. Tell them reinforcements must be dispatched without delay.|Ima-Gun Di and Admiral Dao, during the Battle of Ryloth|<ref name="Supply Lines" />}}
Dao was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Supply Lines" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> elements of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], led by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], invaded and [[Ryloth blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Hoping to counter this threat, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sent a [[Fleet/Legends|task force]] under the command of Dao and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ima-Gun Di/Legends|Ima-Gun Di]] to [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|liberate]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. While Dao oversaw several Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]],<ref name="Supply Lines" /> including his<ref name="Gallery" /> own [[Dao's flagship/Legends|flagship]], Di and a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were sent to aid the embattled Twi'leks on the surface of Ryloth.<ref name="Supply Lines" />

[[File:DaoAndDi.png|thumb|left|250px|Dao speaks with Di during the Battle of Ryloth.]]
As Di and his forces fought the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] forces on Ryloth, Dao and his fleet [[Space warfare/Legends|engaged]] the [[Warship/Legends|warships]] that were part of the Confederate [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the planet in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The battle on and above Ryloth continued for days until the Republic's ammunition, food, and [[Medic/Legends|medical]] supplies on the ground began to run out. Dao was subsequently contacted by Di, who ordered the Admiral to request reinforcements from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. With his own forces low on [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] and ammunition, Dao opened a transmission to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], asking for assistance. However, during the conversation, the Confederate fleet disabled the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] of Dao's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], and a [[Unidentified clone navigation officer (Ryloth)/Legends|clone subordinate]] warned Dao about this development. Dao and the rest of his crew were instantly [[Death/Legends|killed]] when their defenseless [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] fell to enemy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire.<ref name="Supply Lines" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|If help does not arrive soon, the entire Outer Rim garrison will be wiped out.|Admiral Dao, to the Jedi High Council|<ref name="Supply Lines" />}}
Dao had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and fair skin. While speaking with Yoda, Mace Windu, and Obi-Wan Kenobi, Dao desperately tried to persuade the Jedi Masters that reinforcements were needed to maintain the Republic's position on Ryloth, as a defeat there would have major consequences for the [[Gaulus sector/Legends|entire sector]].<ref name="Supply Lines" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|[Ima-Gun Di's] admiral's name is Admiral Dao and those letters are D-A-O. But you could rearrange them to come up with something very similar to his Jedi Master. Like Dead On Arrival.|Dave Filoni, on Dao's naming|<ref name="Names Video" />}}
Admiral Dao was first mentioned in Summer [[2010]] in a promotional video for the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]]. In the video, Series Director [[Dave Filoni]] stated that the inspiration for Dao's name was a rearrangement of the letters of the term D.O.A., or "Dead On Arrival," signifying the character's imminent death in his first appearance in the series.<ref name="Names Video">{{CN|url=promos/201007_secretcode/tools/downloads/video1|text="Names" Video}}</ref> Dao finally appeared in the episode "[[Supply Lines]]," which aired on [[September 24]], 2010. In the episode, Dao was portrayed by voice actor [[James Arnold Taylor]], who also voiced Obi-Wan Kenobi in the series. His design was made to resemble actors who had played [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] in the [[original trilogy]] of ''[[Star Wars]]'' films. His animation model was constructed from Admiral [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen's]] body and the head of a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] citizen, which had both appeared in the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]]. Additionally, his model was customized with a special hair-do.<ref name="Supply Lines Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode303.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Supply Lines}}</ref>
